{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect revenue column
print("Original unique revenue values:", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas, then cast to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("First 5 converted revenue values:", sales['revenue_numeric'].head())

# Check if any rows have revenue 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
